start.dialog: Oink! Terrible news, friend! A phoenix has laid her egg in the Scorched Spire, but ash bandits plan to steal it! Phoenix eggs are priceless—you could buy a kingdom! But the mother will die protecting it. You must stop them!
start.objective: Reach the Scorched Spire before the ash bandits

progress.dialog: You made it first! But here come the bandits—five of them, armed with ice weapons! Phoenix hate cold! Protect the egg while the mother completes her burning cycle!
progress.objective: Defend the phoenix egg from the ash bandits

complete.dialog: The phoenix rises renewed! And look—she left a gift! A Phoenix Down feather. It holds the power of rebirth. Use it wisely, hero. You have earned a place in fire-lore!

party_comments.kade: A real phoenix! That was INCREDIBLE!
party_comments.twist: I got singed. Multiple times. Worth it, I suppose.
party_comments.nix7: Phoenix biology: fascinating. Self-combustion and regeneration cycle documented.
